description: Creates a persistent RTMP/RTMPS ingest point for the authenticated user. Push an encoder to `rtmps_url` with the returned `stream_key`. This is the only response that includes the stream key; read it later with GET /2/sources/:id/stream_key.

region.description: Ingest region, as returned by GET /2/region. us-west-1 and us-west-2 ingest in US West; us-east-1...
